content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Sb fraction 0.160) as the best composition. At 0.102% EQE it was the highest of the five I measured, but I can't confirm it's the best on the whole line, because 25 compositions were never measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.160 | 0.102 |
| 2 | 0.197 | 0.059 |
| 5 | 0.258 | 0.021 |
| 14 | 0.517 | 0.003 |
| 23 | 0.768 | −0.010 |

- **Trend:** EQE drops steadily as Sb increases. I used the last EQE measurement on index 2 to check for a peak just inside the Fe-rich end, but it came in lower than index 0, so none of the measured points beat the edge.
- **Gaps:** Index 1 (Sb 0.178), between the two best points, was never measured. The region from Sb 0.26 to 0.52 is only covered at its two ends, so an isolated high spot in there wouldn't show up.
- **XRD:** The two XRD scans (indices 0 and 2) showed mostly peaks from the platinum substrate, so they didn't identify which phase in the film is doing the work. Three of the five XRD measurements went unused.
- **GP suggestion tool:** It recommended the Sb-rich end (index 18), which the measured trend contradicts, so I didn't follow it.

All five EQE measurements are used.
